title: Banitsa
subtitle: Bulgarian filo pie with cheeses
description: A Bulgarian filo pie of crisp buttered pastry filled with feta, a soft cheese, eggs and goat's yoghurt, baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190°C and grease the baking dish.
Make the filling: mix the cheeses, eggs and yoghurt into a uniform mixture. Add the herbs if you like.

Assemble and bake: brush 2 filo sheets with melted butter one after the other and lay them on top of each other in the dish. Scrunch 4 more sheets and place on top. Pour the cheese mixture over the sheets.
Butter 2 more filo sheets and place over the cheese. If desired, gently score the top of the pie into the slice sizes you want, to make cutting easier after baking.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, until the pastry browns. Remove from the oven and cool slightly before slicing so the pie can set.
